facts: Fully populate CPU/DIMM/HDD/GPU/network slots, then perform 100 cold reboots.
Criteria: no errors, hang/BSOD or device loss.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO and interprets cold reboot as full power off/on.
source_snapshot.v2: MANUAL ONLY with isolation fixture, 100 per-cycle checks and condensation controls.

original_test_intent.statement: Verify a fully populated system survives 100 cold reboot cycles at 0 C/+5% rails without losing devices or producing platform errors.
must_preserve: Full device population, cold reboot semantics, exactly 100 cycles and per-cycle health.
unknowns: Cold-reboot off-time/on-time, boot-complete definition, enumeration baseline and retry policy.

v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: It does not require cycle-indexed stable identity comparison or explicitly forbid resetting the count after a failed cycle.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Retain manual cold-power/environment control and make all 100 cycles individually attributable, with no hidden retry or count reset.

revision_candidate.test_name: Perform 100 Fully Populated Cold Reboots at 0 C and +5% Rails
revision_candidate.purpose: Execute exactly 100 owner-defined full power-off/on cycles and confirm each boot returns the complete baseline CPU, memory, storage, GPU and network inventory without disallowed errors.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Fully populated signed configuration in calibrated 0 C/+5% conditions with condensation-safe power fixture.
revision_candidate.target_scope: The complete serial/BDF/slot/namespace/interface inventory and 100 sequential cold cycles; warm OS reboot is not equivalent.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Cold-cycle waveform/off/on/dwell, boot-ready signal/timeout, full baseline inventory, per-cycle checks, retry/count policy, log allowlist and emergency recovery.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Operator controls environment/power; automated controller may sequence only the approved waveform and capture cycle-numbered boot, inventory and logs. Stop on first defined failure unless policy explicitly says otherwise.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Power fixture isolation, OOB monitoring, filesystem shutdown policy and cold-start condensation controls are proven.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Calibration/waveform trace; full baseline inventory; for cycles 1-100 power times, boot-ready result, inventory diff and OS/BMC/SEL/AER/ECC/XID/storage/network deltas; no missing cycle; final restoration.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: All 100 cycles meet boot timeout, exact required inventory and error criteria; retries cannot erase a failed attempt.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: No warm reboot substitution, log clearing, uncontrolled mains switching, silent retry, shortened count or condensation exposure.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Operator controls chamber/rails/power and emergency response; owner approves waveform and inventories.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Physical power/environment remain manual or operator-supervised fixture actions.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop cycling, leave power in approved safe state, warm/restore nominal conditions, verify data/device health and recover via OOB.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Moisture, unsafe waveform, boot timeout, missing device, filesystem issue, SEL/AER/ECC/XID fault, host/BMC loss or fixture drift.

identified_defects: Cold-cycle waveform and boot boundary absent.
reason_for_change: A final inventory cannot prove that none of the first 99 cold starts lost a device; cycle-indexed evidence and immutable counting are required.
removed_ambiguities: Cold reboot is not OS reboot.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 makes the 100-cycle requirement tamper-evident and links every cold start to a complete device diff, preventing a final healthy boot from masking intermediate loss.

per_case_integrity_check.source_specific_purpose_fact: Row 47 requires fully populated CPU/DIMM/HDD/GPU/network and 100 cold reboots at 0 C/+5%.
